characterization_methods: Electrical conductivity measurements using four-point probe
evidence: Profilometry measurements were performed using a Veeco Dektak 3 stylus profilometer. X-ray reflectivity (XRR) measurements were conducted using a Bede D1 high resolution X-ray diffractometer. Electrical conductivity studies were performed using a Signatone Model S-301-6 four point probe instrument. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was performed on a PHI 5600 X-ray photoelectron spectrometer.
